query_source: new fixed seed; start vertices exclude all old dev/test and pilot starts; freeze before timing
budget: original minimum budget plus common n*8 mapping bytes, frozen before queries
selectors: four deterministic plus five Random-Prune seeds; original representatives and indexes unchanged
inner: per-query warmup; clamp(floor(2ms/warmup_time),1,32), same rule for every method
comparison: partition plus original-layout BFS plus same-layout BFS for each partition layout
timing: native input seeds through fully sorted exact vertex and undirected edge buffers; includes scratch reset, candidate/frontier graph reads, BFS, output; independent validation and warmup excluded
stages: candidate_stage includes its reads; pread_ms overlaps candidate/refinement/output and is not additive
requested_bytes: unique adjacency row bytes fetched per query, including candidate frontier; memory mode is logical access volume, not physical I/O
physical_bytes: Linux /proc/self/io read_bytes delta over timed inner batch; warm page-cache reads must not be described as disk bytes
file_reads: pread with deduplication, contiguous row coalescing and within-query row reuse; shared by BFS and partition
cache: whole adjacency file prewarm before each process and identical per-query warmup
graph_ids: original IDs, physical order only changes
summary_weight: primary two workload means equally weighted; context strata separate, no pooled overall headline
primary: h=1, one seed; 1000 uniform starts and 1000 degree-stratified starts per graph
context: eight remaining strata, 100 new queries each; secondary context only
primary_endpoint: warm-file exact-subgraph total latency, separately by graph and workload, plus equal-weight primary aggregate
other_endpoints: memory latency, requested adjacency bytes, read calls; all other methods and both BFS controls retained
decision: continue only if the primary aggregate time-ratio CI upper bound is below 1 against both Random-Prune and Degree on both graphs, and all four graph/workload point estimates are below 1; report every stratum regardless
uncertainty: paired stratified bootstrap with 2000 resamples of queries and random-seed configurations; three timing repeats collapsed by per-query median
extension: two additional graphs, unchanged engine and settings
